Shambhavi Jha Lead Network Consulting Engineer | Enterprise Networking

+91 9882544385

shambhavi15sj@gmail.com

Bengaluru, Karnataka, India linkedin.com/in/shambhavi15

SUMMARY



Lead Technical Network Subject Matter Expert (SME) with 8.8+ years of expertise in enterprise networking, specializing in routing, network architecture, and WAN technologies. Skilled in diagnosing and resolving complex network issues.

Expertise in designing and building complex lab environments, managing end-to-end case ownership, performing advanced troubleshooting, configuration management, and collaborating with Engineering teams, Product and Customer Success Teams to drive issue resolution, product improvements, and enhanced customer experience.

Hands-on experience with routing protocols (BGP, OSPF, EIGRP, IS-IS), multicast, VXLAN basics, MPLS, and platform- level troubleshooting. Proficient in network automation (Python & Regex) and using tools like IxNetwork and Wireshark for network testing.

Experienced in leading and mentoring technical support engineers/new hires and delivering technical training across enterprise networking domains, contributing to team development and knowledge sharing.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Technical Consulting Engineer, Cisco Systems, Bengaluru

July 2017 - Present

Specialized in Enterprise Routing and Network Architecture, resolving complex customer issues involving routing protocols, platform architecture, and WAN technologies, achieving a 95%+ resolution rate on critical escalations.

Led end-to-end ownership of critical support cases, performing deep technical troubleshooting, managing escalations, and coordinating with engineering teams, reducing average case closure time by 20% while consistently meeting SLA, KPIs (MTTR, response time, CSAT) targets.

Acted as primary escalation point for high-severity (P1/P2) incidents, improving incident response efficiency by 30% through structured troubleshooting and escalation handling.

Led and mentored technical support engineers conducting training sessions, and fostering a collaborative and high- performance team culture, resulting in a 25% increase in productivity.

Ensured prioritization and adherence to SLAs, achieving 100% compliance with response and resolution targets. • Monitored and supported metrics to identify trends, drive operational improvements, and reduce repeat incidents by 25%. • Led complex troubleshooting efforts using tools such as tcpdump, traceroute, nslookup, and log analysis. • Collaborated cross-functionally with engineering, product, sales, and account management teams to resolve customer issues holistically and influence product enhancements through customer feedback.

Replicated customer environments in lab setups to diagnose defects and validate fixes, improving product stability and reducing recurring issues.

Created and maintained technical documentation and knowledge base articles, while developing and delivering training programs that improved team ramp-up time by 40% and increased first-time resolution rates by 15%.

Provided hands-on customer support via phone, email, and remote sessions, ensuring high-quality service delivery and customer satisfaction during critical incidents and high-visibility events (e.g., FIFA, IPL) with 99.99% uptime.

Collaborated in a follow-the-sun global support model, ensuring seamless case handovers and consistent customer experience across regions.

Led process improvement initiatives, optimizing tools, workflows, and support operations, reducing incident response time by



20% and increasing customer satisfaction by 15%. Identified network and capacity constraints in customer environments and partnered with sales teams to recommend solutions, contributing to increased upsell opportunities.

Technical Intern Cisco Systems, Bengaluru

Jan 2017 - Jun 2017

Gained hands-on technical support experience by collaborating closely with Technical Assistance Center (TAC) engineers to handle customer cases and troubleshoot complex network issues.

Developed skills in diagnosing and resolving real-world problems involving routing protocols, network architecture, and WAN technologies.

Collaborated with engineering and product teams to replicate customer environments, identify root causes, and validate fixes for software defects and platform issues.

SKILLS

Routing Protocols: Static Routing, EIGRP, OSPF, BGP, IS-IS, Route Redistribution, VRF Route Leaking, DHCP • Networking Protocols: GRE, FHRP (HSRP/VRRP/GLBP), NetFlow (FNF), Policy Based Routing (PBR), IP SLA, NAT/PAT, QoS, Multicast

WAN: Terminal server, Cellular, PPP/PPPoE, • Hardware Platforms: ASR1k, ISR4k, Cat8k, Cat9k, CSR1v, ISR1k • Programming: Python, Regex • Other Tools: EEM scripting, Wireshark, IxNetwork simulation tool, Cisco quicker, Salesforce Lightning,Traceroute,nslookup • Network Fundamentals: Router Architecture (Control Plane, Data Plane), DNS, TCP/IP, HTTP/S, • Project Management: Waterfall and Agile (Scrum) • Leadership & Team Management: Team Leadership & Mentoring, Performance Management, Training Delivery, Escalation Management, Queue Management & Prioritization, Customer-Centric Support Approach, Process Optimization & Workflow Improvement, Cross-functional Collaboration (Engineering, Product, Customer Success)

CERTIFICATIONS

350-401 - Implementing and Operating Cisco Enterprise Network Core Technologies (CCNP ENCOR) • 300-410 - Implementing Cisco Enterprise Advanced Routing and Services (CCNP ENARSI) • 350-701 - Implementing and Operating Cisco Security Core Technologies (Security-SCOR) • Cisco Certified Network Professional (CCNP) • Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA)

EDUCATION

M.TECH - Software Systems, BITS PILANI • B.E. - Computer Science Engineering, Chitkara University

2021-2023 2013-2017

ACHIEVEMENTS

Enhanced automation tools for crash analysis and bug identification using Python and Regex, streamlining troubleshooting workflows.

Authored internal technical articles to guide engineers in concepts and troubleshooting methods, improving team knowledge and support capabilities.

Authored and published the article “Best Practices for Route-Map Configuration in Cisco IOS XE: Action and Sequence Number Importance” which can be leveraged by individuals and organizations across the globe:

https://www.cisco.com/c/en/us/support/docs/ios-nx-os-software/ios-xe-17/223145-best-practices-for-route-map.html
